ALEX (`who:alex`), relayed by Anthony 2026-08-13, reporting a FIRST RUN ON A REAL WORK PROJECT — the second user again, and the same class as `fact:second-user-report-2026-08-11` and the installer-wording fix: **found by somebody meeting the output for the first time, where nobody who already knew what it did had reason to look.**

HIS WORDS: *"I initialized a new project to try this out with my work. It inserts a .gitignore into the repo. That .gitignore ignores .reflow2 folder. Where does it store the JSON file that can be committed for the graph? I can't find the artifact that can be shared by other project members."* And: *"the init should not write over the .claude/settings.local.json if it already exists."*

BOTH REPRODUCED against HEAD by running `tools/reflow2_init.py` on a scratch project.

═══ 🛑🛑 DEFECT 1 — THE EXPORT EXISTED, WAS DOCUMENTED, AND STILL COULD NOT BE FOUND ═══

⚠️ A FIRST VERSION OF THIS NODE CLAIMED THE CONVENTION WAS UNDOCUMENTED. **That was wrong, and Anthony caught it by asking "didn't we already export the .json file of the graph?"** Corrected here, because the true shape is narrower and more interesting than "nobody wrote it down".

WHAT ALREADY EXISTED:
  · `export_graph` — unchanged, and not the problem.
  · `getting-started/UPDATING.md:19` NAMES IT: *"`docs/design/<name>.json` | the committed export — the durable record | yes, it is in your repo"*.
  · The `ci-gate` and `parallel-work` skills both reference that path.
  · **init ALREADY EXPORTED** — `backup_graph` writes `.reflow2/backups/design-<stamp>.json`.

🛑 AND THAT LAST ONE IS THE DEFECT IN ONE LINE: **`git check-ignore` confirms `.reflow2/backups/design-<stamp>.json` is covered by the `.gitignore:22 -> .reflow2/` rule the same installer writes.** The one export init produced landed INSIDE THE IGNORE RULE. A user who went looking for the shareable artifact found an export that was invisible by construction. The machinery was all present and its output fell in the one directory git was told to skip.

THE SECOND HALF, MEASURED: **nothing INSTALLED INTO THE PROJECT said any of it.** `grep` over what a new project actually receives — `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, the closing summary — returns ZERO hits for `export` or `docs/design`. The only trace is a parenthetical inside the `.gitignore` (*"the durable record is an export"*) which parses only if you already know the word. The real documentation lives in a file about UPDATING and in skills that must be deliberately loaded — **a first run reaches neither.**

⇒ SO IT IS NOT A DOCUMENTATION GAP BUT A REACHABILITY ONE, which is `req:a-discipline-is-delivered-at-the-tool-not-in-a-catalogue`'s shape arriving in the installer: the information existed where the person was not.

📌 KNOCK-ON: `ci-gate` was unreachable for a new project — `reflow2_check.py` runs against a committed export that nothing had produced.

═══ ⚠️ DEFECT 2 — MERGED CORRECTLY, REWRITTEN WHOLESALE, INDISTINGUISHABLE ═══

HIS CLAIM IS HALF RIGHT, AND THE HALF THAT IS WRONG STILL DESCRIBES A REAL DEFECT. Measured with a pre-existing `.claude/settings.local.json` holding a `permissions` block and his own `Stop` hook:

  permissions preserved ......... TRUE (byte-identical)
  his own Stop hook survived .... TRUE (reflow2's appended as a second group)

NOTHING IS LOST ON HEAD. `ensure_hooks` merges, leaves a repointed reflow2 hook alone, and SKIPS on malformed JSON. That landed in `fc6c6d4`.

🛑 **BUT THE WHOLE FILE WAS RE-SERIALISED AT A FIXED 2-SPACE INDENT, so every line changed** — a compact 10-line file came back as 58. **In a `git diff` that is indistinguishable from an overwrite**, and an installer that appears to have rewritten your settings is one nobody trusts near their settings again, which is the standard `ensure_hooks`' own docstring sets for itself.

⚠️ NOT RULED OUT: that Alex is on an OLDER kit whose behaviour genuinely did lose content. `fc6c6d4` is not recent, but a consumer kit can sit releases behind — `ver:kit-manifest-agrees` exists because reflow2's own manifest was four releases stale and nothing noticed. **His version was not established. Ask before concluding the reformat is the whole of what he saw.**
